name: Bar Zoom
author: Joao Victor Ramires Guimaraes Brito
description: Size the Omarchy bar per monitor, and make the Hyprland monitor scale persist per output. Replaces the bar with one that renders at a per-display zoom factor, and gives the Display panel a BAR SIZE row plus a SCALE row that writes each output's own rule.

barWidget.description: Brightness, text size, monitor scale, and per-monitor bar size
